caption: Table 10-10. Cooked ingredient substitution lists.
rows: Starch: These foods in these amounts yield 15 g carbohydrate with 3 g protein, trace fat and 80 kcal
Breadsticks, raisin, rye, whole wheat, white
Bagel, English muffins, buns, rolls, pita, tortilla
Corn on the cob, lima beans, green peas, potato, yam
Protein: Should be weighed after cooking and after bone, skin and excess fat have been removed
Low fat: These foods in these amounts yield 7 g protein with 3 g fat and 55 kcal
Baby beef, chipped beef, flank tenderloin, plate ribs, round (bottom, top), all rump cuts, lean spareribs, tripe, ground beef (>90% lean) and USDA good and choice
Any fresh or frozen, tuna or mackerel canned in water
Low-fat luncheon meats with 3 g fat or less /oz., >90% lean
Chicken or turkey meat without skin
Venison, rabbit, squirrel, pheasant, goose without skin
Medium fat: These foods in these amounts yield 7 g protein with 5 g fat and 73 kcal
Ground beef (>80% lean), corned beef, ribeye
Tuna, salmon canned in oil, drained
Leg, rib, sirloin, loin, shank, shoulder
Low-fat luncheon meats with 3\u20135 g fat/oz., 85\u201390% lean
Loin, shoulder arm and blade, butt
Chicken or turkey meat with skin, duck and goose well-drained of fat
High fat: These foods in these amounts yield 7 g protein with 8 g fat and 100 kcal
Ground beef (<80% lean), brisket, chuck, ribs, USDA prime
Cheese spreads, all regular American, blue, cheddar, Monterey, Swiss
Spareribs, back ribs, ground, country style and deviled ham, sausage
Fats: These foods in these amounts yield 5 g fat with 45 kcal
Margarine with soybean, cottonseed, partially hydrogenated oils, peanut oil, olive oil
Soft tub margarine, oil (safflower, corn, sunflower, cottonseed, sesame)
Diet margarine with safflower, corn, sunflower oil
Chicken fat, beef fat, bacon fat, lard, butter, shortening
Fiber: Grams of dietary fiber per 100 g of these foods
Asparagus, cucumber, lettuce, zucchini, alfalfa sprouts, eggplant, mushrooms, celery, green pepper, tomatoes
Bamboo shoots, carrots, peas, string beans, bean sprouts, chickpea, pinto beans, summer squash, broccoli, cauliflower, pumpkin, turnips, cabbage, kidney beans, spinach, watercress
Beans (white, red, lima, black, broad, soy)
note: 该表为分块式清单：除开头四行的 18-kg/4.5-kg 用量外，各分块（Starch/Protein/Low fat/Medium fat/High fat/Fats/Fiber）按「分类、用量、食物描述」排列，分别落在第 1、2、3 列；分块标题整行置于第 1 列。
